product.description: Ajutați de Sven și de Olaf, Anna și Kristoff au misiunea de a avea grijă de simpaticii puii de troll în lipsa părinților lor, plecați la un festival de profeții. Vor reuși oare să facă față cu succes provocărilor trolilor mici și năzdrăvani, care pot într-o secundă să alerge, să țipe ăi să se cațere în cele mai periculoase locuri? În aceiași colecție au mai apărut: - Un pui de ren simpatic; - Festivalul sfârșitului de iarnă.

# Frozen Kingdom: Who is Afraid of the Littlest Trolls? Stories and Games

Dive into a magical adventure with *Frozen Kingdom: Who is Afraid of the Littlest Trolls?* This delightful storybook series from Litera brings Anna, Kristoff, Sven, and Olaf back to Arendelle for an exciting new chapter. If your child loves fantasy worlds and heartwarming family tales, this book captures the perfect blend of humor and mystery!

## An Adventure in Troll Trouble

In this thrilling installment, Anna and Kristoff find themselves with a crucial mission: caring for adorable troll chicks while their parents are away at the grand Prophecy Festival. But life in Arendelle is never dull! Can they successfully manage the mischievous little trolls? These energetic youngsters are anything but easygoingâthey might sprint across the kingdom one moment, let out a hilarious shriek the next, or climb into the most daring spots imaginable.

This charming narrative follows Anna and Kristoff as they navigate the unexpected chaos of raising tiny, spirited creatures, making it a perfect read for young readers who love action and comedy.

### Explore the World of Arendelle

The *Frozen Kingdom* collection offers more than just one storybook! Fans will also find two other enchanting titles that complement this adventure:
*   A cute reindeer calf tale.
*   The Winter's End Festival celebration book.

Collect these books to give your child a complete journey through the magic and mystery of Arendelle.

---

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**What is this book about?**
This story follows Anna and Kristoff as they take on the challenging role of caring for playful, mischievous troll chicks while attending a prophecy festival in Arendelle.

**Is this suitable for young children?**
The books are designed to be engaging and entertaining for young readers who enjoy fantasy adventures and character-driven stories.

**Does this book belong to a series?**
Yes! It is part of the *Frozen Kingdom* collection, which also includes tales about a reindeer calf and The Winter's End Festival.
